summary.text: Jeffrey Jacks is the Republican candidate for the Missouri House of Representatives, District 72, in the November 3, 2026 general election.
An entrepreneur, he serves as Airport Township Committeeman and previously served as a St. Ann Police Commissioner.

paragraphs.text: Jacks earned a high school diploma from University City High School and has worked as an entrepreneur.

In a Ballotpedia survey, he said his background includes being a registered principal with the National Association of Securities Dealers and working as a mortgage banker, and that he holds an Amateur Radio Extra Class license and CompTIA A+ certification.
Jacks said in the survey that he opposes the St. Louis City-County regional merger proposed by the East-West Gateway Council.

He also said he wants to improve school reading and math performance through phonics-based reading instruction, and he named economic development, constitutional government, education reform and fiscal responsibility as his top areas of interest.
